target.title: fix(discord): skip italics rebalance prepend for code fence and inline code chunks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102911 — when `rebalanceReasoningItalics` splits a reasoning message at a chunk boundary and the next chunk opens with a code fence or inline code backtick, two things go wrong:

1. The reopen path prepends `_` before the backtick, producing `_``` or _` — broken Discord markdown.
2. The close path still appends `_` to the preceding chunk, leaving an unmatched underscore that never gets reopened.

## Why This Change Was Made

The rebalance loop now peeks at both the current chunk and the next chunk before deciding how to balance underscores. When either chunk opens with a backtick (code fence or inline code), both close (current) and reopen (next) are suppressed so no chunk carries an unmatched delimiter.

The three guards:
- `endsWith("_")` — already balanced, skip
- `startsWithCode(current)` — this chunk was not reopened by the prior iteration
- `startsWithCode(next)` — reopening would break the backtick opener

## User Impact

Discord reasoning output containing code blocks at chunk boundaries renders correctly — no broken fences, no orphan underscores.

## Evidence

### Tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts
 ✓ 19 passed  (17 existing + 2 new with balanced-delimiter assertions)
```

### New assertions in the two code-boundary tests

The tests now assert not only that leading `_` is absent, but also that the preceding chunk has no trailing unmatched underscore:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts -- --run 2>&1
 ✓ does not prepend italics underscore to start of chunk when it opens with code fence
   → expect(chunks[fenceIdx - 1].trimEnd().endsWith("_")).toBe(false)
 ✓ does not prepend italics underscore to start of chunk when it opens with inline code
   → expect(chunks[inlineIdx - 1].trimEnd().endsWith("_")).toBe(false)
```

### Lint + Typecheck

```
$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.ts extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts
 exit 0

$ pnpm exec tsgo --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
 (no chunk-related errors)
```

### Repeated regression confirmation

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts  # pass 1
 ✓ 19 passed
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts  # pass 2
 ✓ 19 passed
```

### Files Changed (2 files, +32/-16)

```
 extensions/discord/src/chunk.ts      | 27 +++++++++++++++------------
 extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts | 21 +++++++++++++++++----
```

Production: 1 helper (`startsWithCode`) + simplified loop (17 lines, down from 25). Tests: 2 new boundary-balance assertions on top of the existing negative-match checks.

No config, SDK, CLI, docs, or changelog surface was added. Bounded to `extensions/discord/src/`.
